## Persistence audit, failures and limits

`audit.mjs` uses exact compiled production rules **outside the browser**. All **96 envelope occurrences**, including79 directly importable captured saves and four import copies, decode/encode without relocation. **17 named assertions passed.** Fourteen comparisons verify **the entire state**, including exact ordinary no-input elapsed ticks: rollback72, Dart64/40, Spindle180, capture8/0/88, launch48/40, plus zero-tick reload/import comparisons. Nothing is omitted as an unexplained elapsed field. Save metadata timestamps may change; session/creation provenance stays indexed. `logs/audit.log` and `audit-results.json` retain all results. Compilation emitted test files, but **no test suite was executed**.

No new frozen gameplay/save/render blocker was found. Actual operator failures remain reviewable:

- Off-centre compact return met sealed rooms; subsequent ordinary passage return completed. Wrong-way fresh carrier travel in `f0-west-contact-a/b` is excluded from collision proof. Later attributed controlled collision replaces it.
- Out-of-dock reconfiguration, an initial too-close Creel approach, and out-of-range reboarding refused normally. Two attempted-cut filenames remain swimming/refusals; later saved `f2-creel-reboard-success`, `f2-creel-aligned-mouth` and capture prove correction. The blocker attribution diagnostic explicitly preserves the mixed initial cause.
- A helper expression initially failed whitespace validation; setup clicks then preceded listener installation. Several later panel-button attempts were issued while the pause menu was still open and failed with **“No visible button …”**. The **.259 s menu-only clip** is excluded; menu inspection and deliberate Resume→V opened the panel without advancing the saved lock tick. No control loop timed out or continued unattended.
- An optional offline contact-sheet script lacked Pillow. Four extracted original recording frames remain and were individually inspected; no browser work was repeated for that packaging issue.

Unexecuted criteria remain explicit: campaign carrier acquisition, registered-mobile-refuge loss/fallback, underway walking, deep/all-fleet recovery, human learning/enjoyment/duration, dedicated-GPU performance and audible quality. The M1 interior/disabled-helm drills do not satisfy the M2 mobile-refuge obligation. Thin mid-throat geometry remains separately attributed to original CARRIER rule diagnostics; this run supplies real other-craft obstruction and labelled flag rollback. Full rotating-hull collision/all-heading geometry is not inferred from upright visual/control examples. No fresh expedition or earned P4 peer evidence is claimed.
